notes: This is a quotation-level cross-edition map, not a constant pagination offset.
The cited Navarro page remains the URL locator; the image is a corresponding passage in Martins 1954.
When several cited passages span adjacent documentary pages, the target is the representative page on which the quoted wording was aligned.
1999 is the default for unsuffixed Anch., Teatro citations; citation_year=2006 selects the explicitly cited second edition.
The mappings were derived from served-dictionary quotation context, Internet Archive DjVu OCR candidates, and review of the documentary sequence.
The repeated Na festa do Natal adaptation later in Martins was not substituted for the São Lourenço sequence cited by Navarro.
